package.name: arm_planning
package.description: Module 2 (planning): collision-aware arm planning for the Unitree G1 23-DOF configuration. This catkin package wraps the existing planner in scripts/ with two ROS1 planning services, /arm/plan_to_pose and /arm/plan_grasp_from_point. Planning only -- it never commands the robot; execution is arm_control's /arm/move_arm_joints. Targets are torso_link coordinates and no frame conversion is performed here.
